# Sri Vidhya Overseas

> Overseas education consultants in Warangal and Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Guidance for MBBS abroad, UK education (undergraduate and 1-year Master's), study abroad admissions, scholarships, education loans and student visas. Phone / WhatsApp: +91 85008 05336. First counselling session is free.

## MBBS abroad countries
Russia, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Georgia, Uzbekistan, China, Nepal, Italy — see /mbbs-in-{country}.

## Notes
Fees, eligibility and visa rules on the site are indicative and change regularly. Admission and visa decisions are made by universities and embassies; Sri Vidhya Overseas does not guarantee outcomes.
